nodes.name: vitest.aliases.ts
nodes.summary: Utility module that dynamically generates Vite/Vitest path aliases for every @waggle/* workspace package, mapping them to their src/ directory so tests resolve from TypeScript source without a prior build step.

nodes.name: waggleSrcAliases
nodes.summary: Scans the packages/ directory and returns a Record mapping each @waggle/<pkg> alias to its src/ directory, guarded by the presence of src/index.ts.

nodes.name: vitest.config.ts
nodes.summary: Root Vitest configuration for the waggle-os monorepo, covering all packages with a 30-second timeout and v8 coverage, while explicitly excluding infrastructure-dependent test suites that require live PostgreSQL and Redis.
nodes.languageNotes: Separates infra-gated tests from the default gate so npm test stays green on boxes without Docker, using a dedicated INFRA_TEST_SUITES exclude list.

nodes.name: vitest.infra-suites.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical list of 19 test suite paths that hard-require live PostgreSQL (port 5434) and Redis (port 6381), exported as INFRA_TEST_SUITES and shared between the default and infra-only Vitest configs.

nodes.name: vitest.infra.config.ts
nodes.summary: Dedicated Vitest configuration that runs only the infrastructure-dependent test suites, intended for use after docker-compose brings up PostgreSQL and Redis for a full integration test pass.
